rows.text: Dan Heng! Bronya just sent all of us a message. Did you see it yet?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yes, I saw it.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Then why didn't you reply? Bronya's a good friend of ours!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...I'm sorry, I'm just not in the mood for idle chat. There's been a lot weighing on my mind since the Luofu... it was tough on the spirit.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's so white and fluffy! Where can I find a live one?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: You like animals?
Dan Heng...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm the one who should be sorry — I was being too pushy! You're right, you went through a lot on the Xianzhou — take all the time you need...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Dan Heng, stay on the Express and get some rest.
Why not come with us for a change of scenery?
Thank you for understanding, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No, thanks — I'll be staying on the Express.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's great that Belobog is able to host a celebration. I hope your trip goes well — say hi to our friends for me.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Okay! Rest up — you're not allowed to miss the next Trailblaze expedition!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Mm, I'll be there next time.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hey, March. That's a big smile on your face — what's the good news?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Himeko! There's a celebration coming up on Jarilo-VI, organized by the Supreme Guardian, and we're invited to go take in the sights and sounds.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Dan Heng won't be going anywhere for a while — he's still resting up, so... wanna come with us?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I mean, considering how you helped us out with Cocolia, I'm sure Bronya would be happy to see you!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ahh, so that explains the grin — you're excited about the celebration.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Thanks for the invite, but I'm afraid my hands are full right now. Please send my regards to the Supreme Guardian.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Make the most of the festivities — you've earned it! You two and Dan Heng did help save Jarilo-VI, after all. I'll be sure to join you guys next time.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Navigators really do have their plates full, huh? Seems like it's just you and me this time.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let me go pack some stuff for the trip first. [Trailblazer], come and find me when you're ready to set off.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I've got a lot going on right now, but I'll try to make it next time.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'm sure you'll have a great time. Don't forget to send my regards to the Supreme Guardian while you're there.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So? What do you think about my new dress, [Trailblazer]? Pretty neat, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's actually not new, I just never had the right occasion to try it on.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's been sitting in my wardrobe collecting dust for far too long. But now I've finally got the chance to wear it!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This kind of event doesn't come around every day — why shouldn't I dress for the occasion? ...You're not really gonna wear that same old outfit... are you?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ugh... let's just pretend I never said anything. As long as one of us is making an effort.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Pajamas, hot water bottle, Pom-Pom doll... That should be everything! Let's go!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wow, that was fast... Don't you have anything you wanna bring with you?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Nope, just myself.
Why are you bringing Pom-Pom doll?
My relics all have speed attributes.
Ready to go, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You bet! It's time to celebrate!
Actually, I think I forgot something...
Huh, you do seem to travel light. But... don't you at least need some pajamas!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What? You're still not ready to go?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Alright slowpoke, I'll wait for you here.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, I thought since Pom-Pom can't leave the Express, bringing a doll with us is kind of like taking them trailblazing.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Other people might fall for that, but I won't!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I was just taking a look at Mr. Yang's records, and it seems that Jarilo-VI's average temperature has warmed up quite a bit. It's much warmer than it was on our first trip there.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I wouldn't call it liveable just yet, but things are looking up. I'm so happy for Bronya and Seele.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Belobog, here we come!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wait a sec, [Trailblazer]! That person over there. That doesn't look like a Silvermane Guard uniform...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: All in black, surely they're not... IPC? On this world? Am I going crazy?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: IPC?
What are they doing here?
What an ugly uniform.
The Interastral Peace Corporation — who else? The one whose insignia is pretty much everywhere? That IPC!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You still don't remember? What about "Findie"? That's one of their products... Oh and the Interastral Peace Broadcast! Y'know, the one always being played on the Express!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Never mind, it's not that important. The important question is: What are the IPC doing on Jarilo-VI?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: (Audience cheering)
That's what I'd like to know. If they're here to look for Findie, then they're more than just a little late.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...You think so? I actually think it's pretty snazzy.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Anyway, that's besides the point! The point is, what are the IPC doing here on Jarilo-VI?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: There's only one way to find out — let's go ask. I've always found IPC staff easy to talk to.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hi! Do you work for the Interastral Peace Corporation? Or are you just dressing fancy today?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Tsk, show a little respect! If it weren't for these two, we'd be eating Geomarrow by now!
rows.speaker: Gertie

rows.text: Waiting for Gertie's suncakes...
Boss, encounter with two unknowns. Want me to take them out? Over.
rows.speaker: IPC Worker

rows.text: T—Take us out!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Take them out!? Just hang tight for a second, I'm on my way. Don't do anything stupid.
Glad to make your acquaintance — I'm Topaz, an investment expert from the Interastral Peace Corporation. I'm here on Jarilo-VI for a special business assignment.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: You'll have to forgive my colleague here — people skills aren't his strong suit. Please don't take it to heart.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Whew... You scared the life out of me! We're here for the celebrations — we're not looking for more conflicts...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh, right, we should probably introduce ourselves. I'm March 7th, a passenger of the Astral Express — you may have heard of it? And this is my friend and fellow passenger — [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No kidding! I could tell you weren't locals from a mile away, but I didn't expect to run into two Nameless here! Fate is such a curious thing⁓
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I heard that Jarilo-VI only stepped out of the Stellaron's shadow thanks to the direct intervention of the Trailblazers. Surely, you two aren't...?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Huh? Geez, can you be a little more humble?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So humble all of a sudden, huh? Are you feeling alright? Should I call a doctor?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I never imagined I'd run into living legends here. Must be our lucky day, huh, Numby?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Wow, Miss Topaz, you're really young for an IPC executive! That's impressive!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: More good luck, I suppose. But it's not as cushy as you think — scurrying from one side of the galaxy to the other, going wherever businesses require me to be...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Huh, your job sounds pretty similar to the Express crew's! Aside from the "business," I guess...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Bronya moves fast! The crisis is only just over and she's already opened talks with the IPC.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hehe, these "talks" aren't exactly what you might expect, but I have to agree, the Supreme Guardian definitely knows how to govern a city. That's the reason I'm here on Jarilo-VI — to meet with her.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Miss March, you said you were on your way to the Belobog festivities, right? My apologies for delaying you both!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Don't be sorry! It's not like we're in a rush. Wanna come to the city with us? The Snow Plains are freezing, and it's easier than you think to get lost out here.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Thanks for the concern, but I'll manage. It's my first time on this world — I'd like to take in its vast, iconic snowscape for just a little longer.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Who knows, maybe we'll cross paths again during the celebrations. Oh, here's my contact information. I don't usually respond during work hours, but I'd be happy to chat off the clock⁓
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...Wowwww, I actually managed to get an IPC executive's phone number without even trying.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: M—Me too!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Pfft! As if anyone would ever believe that!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hahaha, you two make a cute pair! Anyway, I'd better be on my way, see you next time!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: The universe is huge, yet we somehow stumbled onto the same path. Fate truly works in mysterious ways, [Trailblazer], don't you think?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Come on, let's head into the city!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wow! There are people everywhere. Are you sure we're in Belobog?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Now to check out the main event — the food! C'mon [Trailblazer], keep up!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Norbert, why don't you tell everyone how you were released from jail so quickly?
rows.speaker: Wallace

rows.text: Selling cultural relics and impersonating Silvermane Guards are both heinous crimes!
rows.speaker: Wallace

rows.text: Well... it was all thanks to my uncle, you know...
rows.speaker: Norbert

rows.text: After some time...
Whew... who'd have thought just taking a stroll could be so tiring?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer], say, I think we should probably pay Bronya a visit. After all, she was the one who invited us here.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Or... we could go check out some other fun stuff elsewhere. Your call!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer], I just remembered Topaz gave me her number.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We might as well just be direct and ask her where she is. She seems like the type of person who appreciates a straight approach.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh! It's you two again. This is the third time today we've run into each other.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Cherish the moment...
Actually, we sent you a message.
Why, of course I will! Meeting friends from the Astral Express is always a moment worth cherishing!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Oh, did my Smart-Reply function tell you where I was? It's a system developed by the Technology Department. Pretty neat, right?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: What do you make of this painting? I'm no expert, but just from the artist's strokes I can tell it's no ordinary piece.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: It portrays a certain kind of... sorrow, you know? Not your everyday kind of sadness — it runs much deeper than that.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: It's as if the artist has condensed history into one poignant, but sorrowful image. The artist's brushwork depicts a generation's — no, several generations' hardships...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Seems like you know your art...
I was thinking the exact same thing.
Not at all, the analysis of an aficionado. I wouldn't take my word for it.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: The Express has visited many worlds. I'm sure the Nameless have a far greater knowledge of such things than myself.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Haha, you flatter me! The Express has visited many worlds. I'm sure the Nameless have a far greater knowledge of such things than myself.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I suppose what I'm trying to say is, what I'm drawn to isn't the style in which a piece is painted, but its overall value. Its intrinsic value may only be 50,000 credits, but its "added value" might push the total up to 200,000.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Ugh... Sorry for crashing your artist party, but we came to talk to you about something else...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh? A collaboration between our two sides, perhaps?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Not exactly. Actually, we—
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's walk and talk — this way!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Miss Topaz, Bronya's already told us about Belobog's debt situation...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Oh? You two are closer than I expected with her.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: So, how can I help? Not sure on the arrangement, or...?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: We... Uh... Help me out here, [Trailblazer]! You know I'm not good at this kinda thing...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We want to ask for a favor on behalf of Bronya.
The IPC's demands are unreasonable.
The Express will pay off Belobog's outstanding debts!
I see.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: You're so direct — I like that!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Hey! Nobody agreed to that!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ahem. We're actually here on behalf of Bronya. It's just, you know... Given Belobog's circumstances, it isn't exactly awash with money right now. The Belobogians don't have the means to pay off such a huge debt.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I understand. From your point of view, I can see how unreasonable it appears.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: However, you must understand that debt collection is a big part of my job. I've dealt with cases far more difficult than Belobog's.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I appreciate each case has its difficulties, but if I treated every late debtor as a "special case," the galaxy's economy would come to a grinding halt.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: What a heartless way of seeing things...
...And if the debt can't be repaid?
Haha~ I've heard that before — more than a few times, actually.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: The Strategic Investment Department is well-versed in handling such situations. We can offer the debtor various repayment solutions...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...but Jarilo-VI has far exceeded the allotted repayment period. I'm afraid milder solutions aren't the order of the day. So, I proposed to Bronya...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Oops! I almost gave away trade secrets there, didn't I? That was a close one.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: The exhibits here are pretty ordinary — I estimate they're probably not worth much. Let's keep moving.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: It's probably extinct.
I absolutely adore them! Have you guys met Numby yet? Aw, where'd they go? They must be off playing somewhere.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Hmm... Come to think of it, this little guy's on display here probably means it's already extinct... right?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I suppose it probably is. Otherwise, it wouldn't be on display here.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: That's such a shame! I absolutely adore little animals! Have you guys met Numby yet? I guess they're off playing somewhere.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: So, Miss Topaz, what exactly will it take for the IPC to go easier on Belobog?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Bronya invested so much just to make this world a little better. And now, it feels like all of her efforts will be undone in the blink of an eye. It's just so cruel...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What do you take the IPC for, Miss March? We're just the same as Belobog's Architects — we're all followers of the Preservation.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: No matter what solutions we propose, we will always take the welfare of the people of Belobog into consideration. Otherwise, we'd be no different from the Legion, would we?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: So you're saying there's nothing to worry about? But Bronya...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't worry yourself too much. The Supreme Guardian is a wise person. She'll understand.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: But to answer your question directly — it'd take a miracle. I'll complete the Jarilo-VI project no matter what obstacles I encounter.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: This isn't going as planned... What should we do?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I wouldn't waste too much energy on this matter. Why not make the most of the festive atmosphere...?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Oh, looks like one of my colleagues is after me. My apologies, but I should probably take this. Bye!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: So... what now? We spent ages trying to convince her and she didn't move an inch!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We didn't promise Bronya we'd succeed.
She sort of made sense...
We should keep pestering her.
Well, yeah, but she'll be really disappointed...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I guess so, but that still doesn't fix Bronya's problem...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You sure? I really don't think she'll change her mind.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I guess Miss Topaz is just doing her job. And as far as the Express is concerned, I think it'd be unwise to make the IPC our enemy.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: All these vested interests — so hard to undo any of it... they don't teach this stuff in school. Wait... did I even go to school?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Did someone send you a message?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Huh? The IPC are causing trouble in the Underworld? Already?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ugh, seriously? Topaz was just talking about "taking the welfare of the people of Belobog into consideration," and now they're pulling this stunt? You really can't trust these money-hungry IPC suits for a minute!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's go save the day.
Here we go again...
That's right! You can't believe a word they say!
Again... I don't think I have it in me to play the hero today!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I really did jinx us! I don't think I have it in me to play the hero today!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I really did jinx us! I don't think I have it in me to play the hero today!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I guess complaining won't get us anywhere. Let's go lend them a hand.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, you two! Cat got your tongue or something? If you knew what was best for you, you'd get out of my way!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: You guys must be exhausted standing here all day. How about you take a little lunch break — I'm sure the IPC allows that, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm a guest of your boss, stand aside.
Seriously, get some lunch bro.
Ugh, what's their deal?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You two were talking to the director in the Snow Plains...
rows.speaker: Quiet Worker

rows.text: Huh!? So it's you! You're the one who was threatening to take us out in the Snow Plains!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hmph, do you even know who you're talking to? If your boss knows to treat us with respect, you'd better start showing some yourself!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I can't let you pass! My team leader said that if anyone gets through, I'll lose six months of performance bonuses!
rows.speaker: Quiet Worker

rows.text: Team leader? Ha, you're even lower on the pecking order than I thought.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sh—Shut up! I spent seven years on a forsaken asteroid preparing to join the IPC — I went through 17 interviews before they finally hired me... What right do you deadbeats have to criticize me!?
rows.speaker: Quiet Worker

rows.text: ...IPC? Interviews!? I don't know what you're rambling on about, but you're really testing my patience.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: [Trailblazer], March — no need to waste our breath on this idiot. Let's do this!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: That's it? He sure took off quickly.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: 17 rounds of interviews and these are the best people they can find? What a joke.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's not get ahead of ourselves. I've been warned that the ones in the mine won't go down without a fight.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: [Trailblazer], let's set off when you're ready.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Ready for action? It's time to kick the IPC out of the Underworld.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Let's go.
Not just yet.
Let's get moving!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Mm, make sure you've got everything you need.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Ready to go, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You bet! It's time to celebrate!
Actually, I think I forgot something...
Belobog, here we come!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What? You're still not ready to go?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Alright slowpoke, I'll wait for you here.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Is everything all right, Bronya? I didn't know Miss Topaz was so... intense. She seemed nice when we met her.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's good to see you two again, welcome back to Belobog. I'd planned a special reception, but I had to deal with an unexpected guest — the lady you just witnessed. She claims to represent the IPC...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: There's no need to keep either of you in the dark. To tell the truth, I've too much weighing on my mind right now to even think about the Solwarm Festival.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: What exactly did Miss Topaz say to you?
I only heard the word "Debt."
Mm... Since you've already made her acquaintance, I needn't explain who she is.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: I'm sure you heard pieces of Belobog's history the first time you visited — the Legion's invasion 700 years ago, how the Stellaron brought about the Eternal Freeze...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: It seems that much of Belobog's history from that time was buried deep beneath the snow. Those memories were lost and weren't passed down to the subsequent generations of Supreme Guardians.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Wow, that's a pretty incredible story. So... does that mean Topaz's "business" here is to collect a debt from Belobog?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yes... I'm afraid so.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: That's ridiculous! And what's with the timing? What took them so long to get here? If it wasn't for us eliminating the Stellaron, they'd have nothing to collect! It's obvious they're just trying to take advantage.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: According to her account, the repayment period agreed upon by the Architects and the IPC investors was... 280 years. However, less than a century after the loan was taken out, the connection between Jarilo-VI and the rest of the galaxy was completely severed.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: The IPC deemed that the disaster had caused irreparable damage and that there was no civilization left to reclaim the debt from. As such, they considered the owed sum permanently lost...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...It wasn't until the Stellaron crisis was resolved that the IPC discovered that Belobog had survived...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: And that's when they sent Topaz over to collect the debt...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...And the interest.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: How much is owed?
What happens if you don't pay it off in time?
An astronomical amount. I don't even know how to read such a long string of numbers.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: The debt owed is an astronomical amount. I don't even know how to read such a long string of numbers.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Before you both arrived, Topaz warned me that if payments were delayed, the IPC would give her the authority to employ "strong measures."
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: I had no idea things were like this. Here I was thinking the IPC had come to rebuild Belobog, not extort it!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Looks like we'll have to intervene.
I doubt the Belobogians can do anything about this on their own...
Yeah! We have to help Bronya out! The IPC is too big and powerful — the Belobogians won't be able to resolve this problem on their own.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Right, we need to figure out how to help them. The IPC is too big and powerful — even if Bronya steps in, it'll be hard for her to resolve the situation...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You seem to have a deeper knowledge of the Interastral Peace Corporation than I do, but if the records are accurate and they truly have a presence throughout the galaxy, the IPC could crush Belobog like a bug if they wanted to.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: I'm glad you're both here — I know you came for the festival, but now...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...Now I must ask you and the Astral Express for help. Do you think you could persuade Topaz to reevaluate the situation? The Express' reputation precedes it, perhaps there's still hope...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Have no fear, Bronya! When a friend's in need, the Nameless will always be at their side!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's go have a chat with Topaz.
Let's bring out the big guns.
Yeah, after all, [Trailblazer] is a pretty good negotiator.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Uh... I don't think we're at that stage yet. Miss Topaz seems like a reasonable person.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: With [Trailblazer]'s silver tongue, I'm sure we'll make some progress.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Thank you so much, both of you. I'm so sorry for dragging you into more trouble.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: While you're out looking for Topaz, I'll see if I can think of a strategy to deal with the situation. Best of luck, and stay safe.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Ahh, I remember! Your uncle is Minister Noel — he heads up the Department of Transportation, no?
rows.speaker: Rossy

rows.text: Ahem... Yes, y—you knew that, too?
rows.speaker: Norbert

rows.text: [Trailblazer], I apologize for dragging you into Belobog's affairs again, but when faced with an entity as powerful as the IPC, we need all the external help we can get.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: While you're out looking for Topaz, I'll see if I can think of a strategy to deal with the situation. Best of luck, and stay safe.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Can you tell me again why Topaz is here?
We'll do our best.
Topaz shared with me the story of the Stellaron's descent upon Jarilo-VI — how the original outsiders stationed here foresaw the impending disaster and chose to leave in large numbers.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Among those outsiders were several investors from the Interastral Peace Corporation. Before they departed, they did something noteworthy...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: They sought out Architects who refused to leave — those who insisted on defending their homes. The IPC provided these Architects with significant funds to aid them against the coming disaster.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: It was with those funds that Belobog was able to construct its immense walls... Even the initial funding for the development of the first batch of automatons was drawn from the same pool.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: According to her account, the repayment period agreed upon by the Architects and the IPC investors was... 280 years. However, less than a century after the loan was taken out, the connection between Jarilo-VI and the rest of the galaxy was completely severed.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: The IPC deemed that the disaster had caused irreparable damage and that there was no civilization left to reclaim the debt from. As such, they considered the owed sum permanently lost...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...It wasn't until the Stellaron crisis was resolved that the IPC discovered that Belobog had survived...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Thank you, [Trailblazer]. I believe in you.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Caught your breath yet, [Trailblazer]? It's time to show these IPC fools who they're dealing with!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: When did you change your clothes?
I didn't think we'd have to fight again...
...Right after we finished chatting with Topaz in the museum.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Did it take you that long to notice, [Trailblazer]? I thought you were supposed to be the observant one!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Nobody did, but it never hurts to be prepared!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Just when I thought I could catch a break, things go haywire! Guess my nice dress will have to wait for a while...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The quicker we handle the IPC, the faster we can get back to enjoying the celebrations. Let Seele know when you're ready to go.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Serval! Serval!
It's actually her! I can't believe it!
Could I pleeease get your autograph?
Come take a look!
Mom, can I get one, pleeeease!?
The line's so long...
Gertie's suncakes are fresh out of the oven⁓
It's been years since I tried one...
They're so cheap... Hope they're safe to eat.
Okay kids, now we're going to learn about the museum...
I'm starving...
Look — a Silvermane Guard! So cool!
Make sure you're all paying attention...
*yawn*
Formation, at ease!
Thieves are rife during times of celebration.
We must be vigilant!
Yes, sir!
Yes, sir!
Master Rossy, may I inquire as to where you'll be employed next?
I'll be helping my father with his affairs...
Oh, and you, Master Norbert?
Me? Why, I'm still going through parol— a period of transformation...
Haha, you're shameless, Norbert! Not to be rude, but if I were thrown in jail, I wouldn't possibly ask my father to bail me out.
rows.speaker: Rossy

rows.text: Do you think I wanted to? I'm not the type of person to abuse my status.
rows.speaker: Norbert

rows.text: Well, I... don't really know about that...
rows.speaker: Wallace

rows.text: Ugh, get off my back, will you? I had to deal with hardened criminals in jail — now that I'm free my supposed "friends" are ganging up on me!
rows.speaker: Norbert

rows.text: Looks like things are getting heated. I think we'd better get outta here.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Next, I'll be introducing the history of the museum. Everyone, listen carefully, okay?
rows.speaker: Pela

rows.text: It's bad — really bad. Their weapons and automatons are much stronger than anything we have.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Nobody's been seriously hurt, but a few Wildfire members got minor injuries. Fortunately for us, it seems like they were holding back.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: You see those two in black? They've been guarding the mine entrance — they're not letting anyone in or out. Hey! Just because you have fancy equipment doesn't mean you can bully us! Who do you think you are?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Who?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Do you think Topaz is around here somewhere? Maybe her cronies are acting without her authorization...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The person you're talking about — are they in charge of the people in black?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Belobog's History and Culture Museum was founded 600 years ago, and was originally built to memorialize Supreme Guardian Alisa...
rows.speaker: Pela

rows.text: Soooo hungry... I wish I could have a Redsunset Salmon right now...
rows.speaker: Children

rows.text: *cough* It was built to memorialize Supreme Guardian Alisa Rand, and also...
rows.speaker: Pela

rows.text: Guess what — I heard there's gonna be a Silvermane adventure camp opening in the Overworld soon. It's gonna be super awesome.
rows.speaker: Children

rows.text: ...Also, those who sacrificed their lives in the war against the invaders 700 years ago...
rows.speaker: Pela

rows.text: Miss Pela! Peter is falling asleep!
rows.speaker: Children

rows.text: Enough! From now on, no whispering allowed! If you don't want to have any homework later, you'd better start listening!
rows.speaker: Pela

rows.text: Sorry, Miss Pela...
rows.speaker: Children

rows.text: That's better. *cough* Now, where was I?
rows.speaker: Pela

rows.text: I never knew Pela had a strict side...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Woo! Thanks everyone! Hope you're ready for a great show! Let's get started!
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: (Singing along)
rows.speaker: Serval and Spectators

rows.text: Aunt Gertie! It's been too long!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ah! Is that little March!? What brings you this way? I heard you left to go travel the galaxy?
rows.speaker: Gertie

rows.text: ...Oh, you're here for the Solwarm Festival, right? The atmosphere is like no other. Silly me, where are my manners? Grab yourselves a suncake each — get 'em while they're hot!
rows.speaker: Gertie

rows.text: Hey, that's not fair! Get to the back of the line. Ever heard of first come, first served?
rows.speaker: Queuing Man

rows.text: Take a look at these beauties! These are the best suncakes I've made all day.
rows.speaker: Gertie

rows.text: Wow, they smell so good! They look so crispy and crunchy! I think I'm in love!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, don't wait for them to get cold now. I'm sorry sweethearts, I'd best see to these other customers before their hunger gets the better of them. Thanks for stopping by!
rows.speaker: Gertie

rows.text: Ta-da! Guess who's back?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's you two! Welcome back to Belobog.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: The Supreme Guardian mentioned there'd be mystery guests attending the Solwarm celebrations, but I didn't think it'd be the Express crew.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: I hope you had a smooth journey. I should have dispatched Silvermane Guards to welcome you on arrival — my apologies.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: It's fine! You really don't have to apologize. We're just passing through, it's no big deal.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Understood. I hope you both enjoy the festivities.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Please make sure you keep your personal belongings safe — pickpockets tend to take advantage of events like this. We'll be performing additional patrols.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Got it! We'll get out of your way, then. Bye!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Bye for now.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Oink! Oink, oink!
rows.speaker: Numby

rows.text: Huh? Looks like Numby's in a good mood.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...But aren't they on the IPC's side? Strange...
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: All the miners here huddled together... anyone else getting déjà vu?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, the situation here is pretty similar to when you first arrived. It's just that instead of a few thugs and broken robots, now we're dealing with much more formidable adversaries.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Hey, [Trailblazer], check it out! Isn't that Topaz's little trotter over there? What was it again... Numby, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What!? Isn't that thing a Fragmentum monster? She's keeping one as a pet!?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: The IPC are all about their sci-fi sorcery, so it's not that surprising. Wanna go take a look?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Oink?
rows.speaker: Numby

rows.text: Oink.
...Oink?
Oink... Grunt, grunt, oink!
Oink... Grunt, oink?
rows.speaker: Numby

rows.text: Oink! Oink oink!
rows.speaker: Numby

rows.text: Oink? Oink, oink... Grunt!
rows.speaker: Numby

rows.text: ...Sounds like you two are getting along! What's Numby saying?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "Topaz isn't here."
"Life is ultimately meaningless."
Not sure, strong accent.
Seriously!? You actually speak trotter?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wow, that's soooo deep... Come on, stop fooling around!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I should've known... Don't quit your day job.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Look, you guys. Looks like it wants to leave.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Looks like they want to find their master. Let's follow them, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Hey, I'm talking to you! Where do you guys store the Geomarrow?
rows.speaker: Bossy Worker

rows.text: I—I really don't know anything!
rows.speaker: Timid Miner

rows.text: Tsk, this place is filled with nothing but incompetents...
rows.speaker: Bossy Worker

rows.text: Those cowards! I guess they wanna do this the hard way!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Oink... Oink! Oink!
rows.speaker: Numby

rows.text: Look — that big guy down there — is he the one in charge?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hmph! We'll see who's really in charge. Let's go!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Phew... So are we all good here, or what?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yeah. Judging by the looks on their faces, I don't think they'll be back.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: So who is this "Topaz" anyway? She seems to have no problem ordering these idiots around, or taming Fragmentum creatures, for that matter...
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: It's a long story...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You're better off asking Bronya.
Belobog is in debt...
Debt? What do you mean?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: You should probably ask Bronya to explain it to you.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Why did this mess have to happen so close to the festivities? The timing couldn't have been any worse.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: ...Oh! Looks like we've got a message.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hmm... I get the feeling Bronya's worried about something. We'd better go back and see her, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Are you coming with us, Seele?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Go on without me, I still have stuff to take care of. The miners need to know what happened here.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Bronya messaged you, which means she thinks you can help. I trust her judgment.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Got it, Seele. We'll do what we can to help Bronya out.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Come on, [Trailblazer], to Qlipoth Fort.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Huh? Where'd Numby go?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wow, for something so short and stubby, he's pretty nimble.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Well, I guess that's that. We're on our own now. Let's keep going.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Yeah! We demand to speak with Topaz!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You know Topaz? Interesting...
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: Meanwhile, at Svarog's settlement...
Hello — it's Mr. Svarog, isn't it? And this cute little girl must be Clara!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: H—Hello Miss... Are you...?
rows.speaker: Clara

rows.text: I'm Topaz! I've come to have a chat with Mr. Svarog.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Clara, go inside and wait for me.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: Huh? But if you have a guest, maybe I should...
rows.speaker: Clara

rows.text: She is not a "guest," neither is she a friend.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: Go, Clara. Everything will be fine.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: So, it seems my source was right: Who'd have thought that such a strong bond could exist between a giant robot and a little girl...? So heartwarming!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: You bear the insignia of the Interastral Peace Corporation. What is your motive for coming here?
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: Straight to the point, huh? I like your style.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Jarilo-VI — are robots familiar with that term? Anyway, it refers to the planet we're currently standing on. It's about to become the property of the IPC.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: No one can reverse this outcome. Not you, not the Nameless, nor any power in the galaxy.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I only care about one thing right now — demonstrating to the shareholders of the IPC that Jarilo-VI can generate value.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: In the long run, this is a way — the ONLY way — to ensure Belobog's long-term interests. I need your help to achieve this goal.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: "Long-term interests" undefined. Analyzing objectives...
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: Analysis: Failed. Tell me, emissary — how do you plan to convince the IPC leadership?
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: That's simple, I'll show you.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: This is...
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: Source code. Or to be more precise — source code that is able to take control of all mechanized units in Belobog.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I'm sure you're familiar with this — all mechanized units manufactured in Belobog over the last 700 years utilize the underlying systems created by the IPC. The code is so refined that the engineers never saw any reason to change it.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I assume you're also aware that there was once a large automaton factory in the Underworld. Thousands upon thousands of automatons — enough to crush the Legion's vanguard — lay dormant within.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: This is my bargaining chip for negotiating with the higher-ups. I'll convince them that Jarilo-VI has a place in the company's long-term strategies.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: But first, I need a guide to show me where these automatons are buried.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I understand. Your "long-term interests" can be defined as the survival of civilization at a macro level.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: What are your intentions for the people currently living here?
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: Their future has already been purchased. All I can do is make them accept this fact, using a relatively peaceful approach.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I understand. I will assist you with your plan.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: ...Oh? So, you're not as stubborn as the rumors suggest.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: The future you speak of is beyond my computational range. But my emotional analysis indicates that you are indeed trying to find ways to ensure the survival of this world.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: Additionally, calculations indicate a 96.4% probability of compliance through force if I refuse to cooperate.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: Your calculations are slightly on the conservative side.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Here's to our future cooperation! If you wouldn't mind leading the way, Mr. Svarog.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Hey, you! Are you in charge around here?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: A local? The IPC is currently conducting asset evaluation work here. Local residents are advised to follow those responsible for evacuation to the—
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: Don't lie to us! You seized the mine by force for yourself — you drove the locals out of their homes!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: I'm warning you — get lost or suffer the consequences! Don't you dare show your face around here again!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: And who might you be? You have quite the attitude... This is our jurisdiction now — we are all-powerful here.
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: It doesn't matter. The Strategic Investment Department has no obligation to talk to anyone not related to this project!
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: In cases where debtors fail to repay within the set time frame, the IPC reserves the right to skip negotiations and take over all assets. We're simply following the rules — what exactly is your problem?
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: Y'know, it's funny how the "rules" always seem to work in your favor, don't you think? This world's been hanging by a thread and now you're here to pull the plug on it!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hmph, don't blame me, I'm simply following orders. Do you think I get to make those kinds of decisions?
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: Save your breath, March. I never held out any hope of resolving this problem peacefully.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Didn't you claim the IPC was all-powerful? Well now's the perfect chance to show us what you can do!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Ugh, if I knew things were going to get this heated, I'd have applied for overtime...
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: Ahem... Anyway! Since you seem intent on settling this matter with violence, prepare yourselves for my heavy laser cannon!
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: Ugh... Wh—Who are you people? Not even our tech could take you down...
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: Pfft! We took down the Doomsday Beast, the Stellaron, and Phantylia. Did you really think YOU could stop us?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Darn it! I'm all out of ammo...
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: Sir, we've just received word from the director...
rows.speaker: Nervous Worker

rows.text: Director Topaz? What did she say?
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: Teams are not to disrupt the lives of local inhabitants during the asset evaluation period...
rows.speaker: Nervous Worker

rows.text: Teams that violate this directive will have their year-end bonuses reduced by 60%...
rows.speaker: Nervous Worker

rows.text: 60%!? We're done for!
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: Attention all personnel. Evacuate the mine immediately! Erase all traces of your presence!
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: Wow! We wiped them all out in a single explosion! That's what you call efficiency!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's a shame we had to resort to this method, but we had no choice.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: You Silvermane Guards sure are a righteous bunch...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Woohoo! The coast is clear!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: To be honest, I didn't think it would be so powerful... Good thing everything went according to plan.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Is this really the right place...? It's so quiet all of a sudden.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This atmosphere really feels strange... Are you sure Topaz is here?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wow... I didn't expect to find a place like this in the Underworld!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I wonder why Topaz would come to a place like this...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Topaz disappeared after leaving Rivet Town. In her absence, her subordinates flooded in and took over.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: The IPC soldiers are well-equipped — it wouldn't be wise to fight them head-on. Captain, what do you have in mind?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You're right, Miss Himeko. We'll be using the Automaton Stealth Bomb to cover our tracks.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Automaton... Stealth Bomb?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'll explain later. Let's get moving.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Look — down there! It's the IPC!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Keep noise to a minimum — everyone. We don't want to alert the enemy to our presence.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: It's time to deploy the Automaton Stealth Bomb.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: I've seen standard-issue robots like these before. It's an IPC field Team Leader.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Correct — the exterior is similar to the Grizzly, but its weapons and armor are more advanced.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Hopefully, the Automaton Stealth Bomb will still be effective. [Trailblazer], let me know when you're ready.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: This is the road that Topaz took when she left Rivet Town.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Let's find her and tell her about Bronya's decision.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: This time, the gloves are off!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer], where are you going? Come back!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I know that your urge to fight is overwhelming... but let's use the Automaton Stealth Bomb this time.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Do you think... my dad was trying to discourage me from playing Aetherium Wars?
rows.speaker: Confident Youth

rows.text: Mr Svarog! Are you alright? I hope Topaz and her IPC henchmen didn't hurt you.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Greetings, outsiders. System functions are normal — I have had no conflict with the IPC's representatives.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: I thought we might be facing off against each other for a moment.
Such a result would be highly undesirable.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: Topaz is ahead. She had the means to force me to comply with her orders, but chose not to.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: From her perspective, the only way to "preserve" Belobog is by incorporating it into the IPC. While I do not agree with her viewpoint, I lack the computational power to provide evidence to the contrary.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: While it is unlikely, I still encourage the avoidance of any potential conflicts.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: "Unlikely, potential..." meaning there could still be conflicts...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't worry, March. The Express never pursues conflict as a first means... but if it comes down to it, we won't back down either. That's how it's always been.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Himeko's right. As long as we can look at ourselves in the mirror and know we did the right thing, that's all that matters.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Are you ready, [Trailblazer]? Use the Automaton Stealth Bomb to wipe out the IPC threats.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Ready.
Remember, try to avoid being noticed. Remaining hidden will increase our chances of success.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Oh no, they saw right through it...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's alright — we prepared many backups. Try again.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Himeko is that famous?
Of course! The Nameless have quite the reputation — you're following in the footsteps of the great Akivili, after all!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Do I have any fans?
I'd be surprised if you didn't! Don't underestimate the reputation of the Nameless out among the stars — you're following in the footsteps of the great Akivili, after all!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I'm pleased to see how well everyone's been getting along. Topaz, based on your greeting I presume you have a good grasp of the current situation?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Approval for what?
You're very curious about my work, aren't you?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Your vacation time has been approved?
Haha, I wish!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: So many eager faces — I won't keep you in the dark any longer.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Oh, hey there slowpokes! I was starting to think you weren't gonna show up.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Hmm... This lady next to Miss March looks oddly familiar.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Pleasure to meet you, Miss Topaz. I'm Himeko, the Astral Express' navigator.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Oh wow, I remember now, the illustrious Miss Himeko! Some of my colleagues dream about meeting you!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Of course! The deadline has already passed, but Bronya still hasn't signed the contract. I think I can guess what's holding her back...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Please don't misunderstand us, Miss Topaz. We have no intention of opposing the IPC or its board of directors... but we have very dear friends on Jarilo-VI.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Standing idly by and watching them sign an unfair contract... goes against everything the Nameless are about.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Um... Miss Himeko, sorry for interrupting, but this doesn't sound like a negotiation...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We needn't waste our time, March. She made her decision ten minutes ago.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Haha, there's no fooling the Astral Express!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: You're absolutely right. Differing views don't necessarily mean one person is right and the other is wrong. However, to keep things moving forward, there's usually only one solution...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Huh? Wh—What do you mean?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: My superiors have granted me the approval I need.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Approval to launch an attack on the members of the Astral Express...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Incredible! No wonder the Astral Express is so highly regarded!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Finished warming up? Now it's my turn...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Stop! All of you! Put down your weapons!
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: B—Bronya? You're here just in time! Things were about to get out of control!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Supreme Guardian? I was starting to wonder whether you'd left the Express crew to fend for themselves! That would hardly be becoming of you.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I would never do such a thing. There was an important matter that required my attention.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...MORE important than this?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Yes. I think you'll understand the significance once you see it... In short, I need you to help us evaluate our current progress.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...Help you? Hmm, that's interesting. I was under the impression you'd already decided to obstruct our operations here.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I have read your letter word for word, Miss Topaz, and your childhood experiences truly touched me.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Your hometown once experienced a similar catastrophe to Jarilo-VI, so I can understand your perspective on the issue and the position you have taken.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: It's because of this empathy you have, that I still hold out a glimmer of hope. Despite all that's happened, I hope we can still find common ground... through peaceful means.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...I have to admit, talking to you is always such a pleasure. I apologize for my behavior just now, it was... inappropriate.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I admire your determination. Seeing as we've come this far... I've changed my mind — I'll hold off a little longer and see what you have to show me. But remember — winning over the higher-ups won't be easy.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I understand. That's why I've been taking things one step at a time. The first step was changing your mind.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Members of the Express, we'll need your help, too.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: 600 years old...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Provisional evaluation would value it at approximately 270,000...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: With 34 of this type of painting...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: That comes to 9,180,000...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Most exhibits in this museum are of little value.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: But with a keen eye, it's possible to find a diamond in the rough, so to speak.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: So you're basically saying the Belobogians must pay off their ancestors' debts...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: When you think about it, it's just another part of the cycle of life.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...Uh, I'm not sure it's as poetic as that...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wow, look! Is that little critter native to Jarilo-VI!?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Oh! It's you two again. This is the third time today we've run into each other.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Cherish the moment...
Why, of course I will! Meeting friends from the Astral Express is always a moment worth cherishing!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Actually, we sent you a message.
Oh, did my Smart-Reply function tell you where I was? It's a system developed by the Technology Department. Pretty neat, right?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: What do you make of this painting? I'm no expert, but just from the artist's strokes I can tell it's no ordinary piece.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: It portrays a certain kind of... sorrow, you know? Not your everyday kind of sadness — it runs much deeper than that.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: It's as if the artist has condensed history into one poignant, but sorrowful image. The artist's brushwork depicts a generation's — no, several generations' hardships...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Seems like you know your art...
Not at all, the analysis of an aficionado. I wouldn't take my word for it.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I was thinking the exact same thing.
Haha, you flatter me! The Express has visited many worlds. I'm sure the Nameless have a far greater knowledge of such things than myself.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: The Express has visited many worlds. I'm sure the Nameless have a far greater knowledge of such things than myself.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I suppose what I'm trying to say is, what I'm drawn to isn't the style in which a piece is painted, but its overall value. Its intrinsic value may only be 50,000 credits, but its "added value" might push the total up to 200,000.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Ugh... Sorry for crashing your artist party, but we came to talk to you about something else...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh? A collaboration between our two sides, perhaps?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Not exactly. Actually, we—
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's walk and talk — this way!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Miss Topaz, Bronya's already told us about Belobog's debt situation...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Oh? You two are closer than I expected with her.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: So, how can I help? Not sure on the arrangement, or...?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: We... Uh... Help me out here, [Trailblazer]! You know I'm not good at this kinda thing...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We want to ask for a favor on behalf of Bronya.
I see.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: The IPC's demands are unreasonable.
You're so direct — I like that!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: The Express will pay off Belobog's outstanding debts!
Hey! Nobody agreed to that!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I understand. From your point of view, I can see how unreasonable it appears.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Ahem. We're actually here on behalf of Bronya. It's just, you know... Given Belobog's circumstances, it isn't exactly awash with money right now. The Belobogians don't have the means to pay off such a huge debt.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: However, you must understand that debt collection is a big part of my job. I've dealt with cases far more difficult than Belobog's.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I appreciate each case has its difficulties, but if I treated every late debtor as a "special case," the galaxy's economy would come to a grinding halt.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: What a heartless way of seeing things...
Haha~ I've heard that before — more than a few times, actually.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...And if the debt can't be repaid?
The Strategic Investment Department is well-versed in handling such situations. We can offer the debtor various repayment solutions...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...but Jarilo-VI has far exceeded the allotted repayment period. I'm afraid milder solutions aren't the order of the day. So, I proposed to Bronya...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Oops! I almost gave away trade secrets there, didn't I? That was a close one.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: The exhibits here are pretty ordinary — I estimate they're probably not worth much. Let's keep moving.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: It's so white and fluffy! Where can I find a live one?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: You like animals?
I absolutely adore them! Have you guys met Numby yet? Aw, where'd they go? They must be off playing somewhere.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: It's probably extinct.
I suppose it probably is. Otherwise, it wouldn't be on display here.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Hmm... Come to think of it, this little guy's on display here probably means it's already extinct... right?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: So, Miss Topaz, what exactly will it take for the IPC to go easier on Belobog?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's such a shame! I absolutely adore little animals! Have you guys met Numby yet? I guess they're off playing somewhere.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Bronya invested so much just to make this world a little better. And now, it feels like all of her efforts will be undone in the blink of an eye. It's just so cruel...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What do you take the IPC for, Miss March? We're just the same as Belobog's Architects — we're all followers of the Preservation.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: No matter what solutions we propose, we will always take the welfare of the people of Belobog into consideration. Otherwise, we'd be no different from the Legion, would we?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: So you're saying there's nothing to worry about? But Bronya...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't worry yourself too much. The Supreme Guardian is a wise person. She'll understand.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: But to answer your question directly — it'd take a miracle. I'll complete the Jarilo-VI project no matter what obstacles I encounter.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: This isn't going as planned... What should we do?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I wouldn't waste too much energy on this matter. Why not make the most of the festive atmosphere...?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Oh, looks like one of my colleagues is after me. My apologies, but I should probably take this. Bye!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: So... what now? We spent ages trying to convince her and she didn't move an inch!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We didn't promise Bronya we'd succeed.
Well, yeah, but she'll be really disappointed...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: She sort of made sense...
I guess so, but that still doesn't fix Bronya's problem...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We should keep pestering her.
You sure? I really don't think she'll change her mind.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I guess Miss Topaz is just doing her job. And as far as the Express is concerned, I think it'd be unwise to make the IPC our enemy.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: All these vested interests — so hard to undo any of it... they don't teach this stuff in school. Wait... did I even go to school?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Did someone send you a message?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Huh? The IPC are causing trouble in the Underworld? Already?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ugh, seriously? Topaz was just talking about "taking the welfare of the people of Belobog into consideration," and now they're pulling this stunt? You really can't trust these money-hungry IPC suits for a minute!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's go save the day.
Again... I don't think I have it in me to play the hero today!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Here we go again...
I really did jinx us! I don't think I have it in me to play the hero today!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's right! You can't believe a word they say!
I really did jinx us! I don't think I have it in me to play the hero today!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I guess complaining won't get us anywhere. Let's go lend them a hand.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer], I just remembered Topaz gave me her number.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We might as well just be direct and ask her where she is. She seems like the type of person who appreciates a straight approach.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, you two! Cat got your tongue or something? If you knew what was best for you, you'd get out of my way!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: You guys must be exhausted standing here all day. How about you take a little lunch break — I'm sure the IPC allows that, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm a guest of your boss, stand aside.
Seriously, get some lunch bro.
Ugh, what's their deal?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You two were talking to the director in the Snow Plains...
rows.speaker: Quiet Worker

rows.text: Huh!? So it's you! You're the one who was threatening to take us out in the Snow Plains!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hmph, do you even know who you're talking to? If your boss knows to treat us with respect, you'd better start showing some yourself!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I can't let you pass! My team leader said that if anyone gets through, I'll lose six months of performance bonuses!
rows.speaker: Quiet Worker

rows.text: Team leader? Ha, you're even lower on the pecking order than I thought.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sh—Shut up! I spent seven years on a forsaken asteroid preparing to join the IPC — I went through 17 interviews before they finally hired me... What right do you deadbeats have to criticize me!?
rows.speaker: Quiet Worker

rows.text: ...IPC? Interviews!? I don't know what you're rambling on about, but you're really testing my patience.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: [Trailblazer], March — no need to waste our breath on this idiot. Let's do this!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: That's it? He sure took off quickly.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: 17 rounds of interviews and these are the best people they can find? What a joke.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's not get ahead of ourselves. I've been warned that the ones in the mine won't go down without a fight.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: [Trailblazer], let's set off when you're ready.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Is everything all right, Bronya? I didn't know Miss Topaz was so... intense. She seemed nice when we met her.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's good to see you two again, welcome back to Belobog. I'd planned a special reception, but I had to deal with an unexpected guest — the lady you just witnessed. She claims to represent the IPC...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: There's no need to keep either of you in the dark. To tell the truth, I've too much weighing on my mind right now to even think about the Solwarm Festival.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: What exactly did Miss Topaz say to you?
Mm... Since you've already made her acquaintance, I needn't explain who she is.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: I only heard the word "Debt."
I'm sure you heard pieces of Belobog's history the first time you visited — the Legion's invasion 700 years ago, how the Stellaron brought about the Eternal Freeze...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: It seems that much of Belobog's history from that time was buried deep beneath the snow. Those memories were lost and weren't passed down to the subsequent generations of Supreme Guardians.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Wow, that's a pretty incredible story. So... does that mean Topaz's "business" here is to collect a debt from Belobog?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yes... I'm afraid so.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: That's ridiculous! And what's with the timing? What took them so long to get here? If it wasn't for us eliminating the Stellaron, they'd have nothing to collect! It's obvious they're just trying to take advantage.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: According to her account, the repayment period agreed upon by the Architects and the IPC investors was... 280 years. However, less than a century after the loan was taken out, the connection between Jarilo-VI and the rest of the galaxy was completely severed.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: The IPC deemed that the disaster had caused irreparable damage and that there was no civilization left to reclaim the debt from. As such, they considered the owed sum permanently lost...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...It wasn't until the Stellaron crisis was resolved that the IPC discovered that Belobog had survived...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: And that's when they sent Topaz over to collect the debt...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...And the interest.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: How much is owed?
An astronomical amount. I don't even know how to read such a long string of numbers.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: What happens if you don't pay it off in time?
The debt owed is an astronomical amount. I don't even know how to read such a long string of numbers.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Before you both arrived, Topaz warned me that if payments were delayed, the IPC would give her the authority to employ "strong measures."
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: I had no idea things were like this. Here I was thinking the IPC had come to rebuild Belobog, not extort it!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Looks like we'll have to intervene.
Yeah! We have to help Bronya out! The IPC is too big and powerful — the Belobogians won't be able to resolve this problem on their own.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I doubt the Belobogians can do anything about this on their own...
Right, we need to figure out how to help them. The IPC is too big and powerful — even if Bronya steps in, it'll be hard for her to resolve the situation...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You seem to have a deeper knowledge of the Interastral Peace Corporation than I do, but if the records are accurate and they truly have a presence throughout the galaxy, the IPC could crush Belobog like a bug if they wanted to.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: I'm glad you're both here — I know you came for the festival, but now...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...Now I must ask you and the Astral Express for help. Do you think you could persuade Topaz to reevaluate the situation? The Express' reputation precedes it, perhaps there's still hope...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Have no fear, Bronya! When a friend's in need, the Nameless will always be at their side!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's go have a chat with Topaz.
Yeah, after all, [Trailblazer] is a pretty good negotiator.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's bring out the big guns.
Uh... I don't think we're at that stage yet. Miss Topaz seems like a reasonable person.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Thank you so much, both of you. I'm so sorry for dragging you into more trouble.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: With [Trailblazer]'s silver tongue, I'm sure we'll make some progress.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: While you're out looking for Topaz, I'll see if I can think of a strategy to deal with the situation. Best of luck, and stay safe.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Caught your breath yet, [Trailblazer]? It's time to show these IPC fools who they're dealing with!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: When did you change your clothes?
I didn't think we'd have to fight again...
...Right after we finished chatting with Topaz in the museum.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Did it take you that long to notice, [Trailblazer]? I thought you were supposed to be the observant one!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The quicker we handle the IPC, the faster we can get back to enjoying the celebrations. Let Seele know when you're ready to go.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Nobody did, but it never hurts to be prepared!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Just when I thought I could catch a break, things go haywire! Guess my nice dress will have to wait for a while...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Okay, got it. She's at the museum — let's get going.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We better think about what we're gonna say. She might be young, but she is an IPC executive — she's definitely no pushover.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What's going on?
It's bad — really bad. Their weapons and automatons are much stronger than anything we have.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Is anyone hurt?
Nobody's been seriously hurt, but a few Wildfire members got minor injuries. Fortunately for us, it seems like they were holding back.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: You see those two in black? They've been guarding the mine entrance — they're not letting anyone in or out. Hey! Just because you have fancy equipment doesn't mean you can bully us! Who do you think you are?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Is Topaz around?
Who?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: We'll handle this.
Do you think Topaz is around here somewhere? Maybe her cronies are acting without her authorization...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The person you're talking about — are they in charge of the people in black?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: I understand the difficulties that this world is facing, Supreme Guardian. Belobog's current financial burden cannot be pinned on you, nor anyone else for that matter.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: However, objectively speaking, since Belobog has existed as an independent entity to this day, its debt cannot simply be written off.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...Oh, it looks like we have some visitors!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Bronya! And... Topaz? You're here too?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I guess you've already started your business talks. We'll get out of your way if—
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's no bother, we've pretty much wrapped things up already, anyway.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Please consider my plans carefully, Supreme Guardian. If Jarilo-VI wants to rebuild its connections with the rest of the galaxy, your credit record with the IPC will be of great importance.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...You've made yourself clear, Miss Topaz. I'll require some time to consider my next course of action.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Naturally. However, while you're deliberating, my colleagues will need to carry out some operations in Belobog. I hope that your subjects in the Underworld are... cooperative.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I'm sorry our business got in the way of a reunion with old friends. I'll get out of your way.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Seele!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey! Am I glad to see you two here — I'm not sure how much longer we can hold out.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Nobody's been seriously hurt, but a few Wildfire members got minor injuries. Fortunately for us, it seems like they were holding back.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Their weapons and automatons are much stronger than anything we have.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: What's the matter? Got nothing to say!?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: What's going on inside the mine? Any ideas?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: A few miners made it out earlier — they looked pretty panicked. They said the whole mine had been seized by the people in black.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: These uninvited guests keep talking about "asset evaluation," whatever that means. All I know is they're seriously disrupting the lives of the Underworlders!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: We were just talking to her in the museum... Do you think her cronies are acting without her authorization?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Potaz, Pazto — whatever her name is, she can wait. Right now, the most important thing is to free those trapped in the Great Mine. Are you two with me?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Alright, if we want to make an informed decision, we need to hear from both the Overworld and the Underworld, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's start with the Overworld.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Whoa, the fort's packed... I've never seen this many people here before.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Geez... I can barely even hear myself think!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What a dismal sight. This district... Have you been here before?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Yes... This is where we put an end to it all...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...And then began again.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That's right.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...What is this place? We've never been here before, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Mm, we've only recently discovered this domain.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Let's keep moving forward. What I want to show you is just ahead.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: I've been wondering, how did you figure out what was happening here on Belobog, Himeko?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, you know, keeping an eye on the crew is just another part of a navigator's job.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Well, well, look who we have here! [Trailblazer] and March, paying us a visit. What's the occasion?
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: We need your opinion on an important matter.
Uh-oh, sounds like something serious is happening. You'd better fill me in.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: You tell Serval about the IPC debt and the choice facing Bronya...
...What? How is that possible? I need a moment to wrap my head around this...
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: Serval, we're racing against the clock! No time for head-wrapping.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...It's okay, I've thought it through... If it were up to me, I'd... sign the contract.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: What!? Hold on, are you serious? I thought you'd be against it for sure!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Surprised? My reasons are pretty simple.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: Signing this contract would mean we no longer have to worry about "surviving." For most of the residents here, especially those in the Underworld, that would be more than enough to persuade them.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: As for working for the company, pfft, people need to work no matter where they are, right? If the IPC tries to take too many liberties, we can always rise up against them!
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: You know, I've always longed for the stars since I was a child, which is why I devoted myself to science and the studying of the Stellaron. If someone told me that I could do whatever research I wanted, with only a small price to pay... I probably wouldn't hesitate.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: I see... I suppose that makes sense.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Thanks for your input. I'll make a note of your opinion.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We meet again! How have you two been?
rows.speaker: Pela

rows.text: Uh-oh... That look on [Trailblazer]'s face tells me something's wrong. I hope it's nothing too serious.
rows.speaker: Pela

rows.text: We need your opinion on an important matter.
Sounds serious. I'm all ears.
rows.speaker: Pela

rows.text: You tell Pela about the IPC debt and the choice facing Bronya...
Really...? You better not be making things up!
rows.speaker: Pela

rows.text: I wish it were made up... Unfortunately it's all true.
